invariant: i ≤ a.size ∧ (ok = true ↔ ∀ k, k < i → a[k]! = a[0]!)

lemmas.name: allsame_arr_pairwise
lemmas.statement: ∀ (a : Array Int), (∀ k, k < a.size → a[k]! = a[0]!) → List.Pairwise (· = ·) a.toList
lemmas.proof:
by intro a h
  apply List.pairwise_of_forall_mem_list
  intro x hx y hy
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := (Refine.mem_iff_idx a.toList x).mp hx
  obtain ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩ := (Refine.mem_iff_idx a.toList y).mp hy
  have hi' : i < a.size := by simpa using hi
  have hj' : j < a.size := by simpa using hj
  rw [Refine.toList_getElem_bang a i hi', Refine.toList_getElem_bang a j hj', h i hi', h j hj']

lemmas.name: allsame_arr_not
lemmas.statement: ∀ (a : Array Int), 0 < a.size → ¬ (∀ k, k < a.size → a[k]! = a[0]!) → a.toList.any (fun x => decide (x ≠ a.toList[0]!)) = true
lemmas.proof:
by intro a h0 h
  push_neg at h
  obtain ⟨k, hk, hne⟩ := h
  rw [List.any_eq_true]
  have h00 : a.toList[0]! = a[0]! := Refine.toList_getElem_bang a 0 h0
  refine ⟨a[k]!, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← Refine.toList_getElem_bang a k hk, getElem!_pos a.toList k (by simpa using hk)]; exact List.getElem_mem _
  · rw [h00]; simpa using hne
